provenance.authoring_method: short-term compatibility: OpenUSD doors plus registered floor-plan anchors
provenance.rehabilitation_row_correction: floor-plan labels aligned to USD doors door-050..door-057; spinal-cord rehabilitation split into west and east entrances
provenance.consulting_room_correction: 诊室组拆分为上侧、左下、右下三个OpenUSD门入口；原咨询室移回东侧挂号区平面图位置
provenance.service_machine_correction: two self-service registration/payment points and one self-service report point matched to visible floor-plan equipment
provenance.lower_floor_amenities_supplement: 补充右下楼梯、左下卫生间以及左右下方无障碍卫生间
provenance.infusion_nebulization_alignment_correcti: 输液室与雾化室按平面图独立门洞重标；附近USD门簇尚无法可靠区分，两个入口位姿均为临时注册值
provenance.safegate_location_policy: 当前白名单由 semantics/safegate_first_floor_allowlist.json 管理。
provenance.business_attachment_policy: one nearby structure edge per business location; operator-confirmed direct links additionally connect information desk to 40/49 and medication consultation to south functional-exam corridor
provenance.functional_exam_navigation_policy: 功能检查分诊、B超、TCD、心电统一导航到sg-f1-functional-exam-waiting（显示编号28）
provenance.topology_optimization: corridor-13 is routed through the blank public area west of the elevator shafts; pharmacy, emergency, infusion, nebulization, and elevator interiors are no-through zones

policy.selection_rule: 从当前定位节点到每个候选节点计算可通行图路径；选择累计 distance_m 最小者。不可达、权限不足或 navigation_status 非 open 的候选节点不得参与比较。
policy.tie_break_rule: 路径长度相同，按 candidate_node_ids 的书写顺序选择。
policy.fallback_rule: 全部候选不可达时返回 NO_REACHABLE_DESTINATION，不得回退到 legacy_default_node_id。

annotation_guide.purpose: Human floor-plan lookup data is stored outside the executable graph nodes.
